resources.string: RAM, zram, partitions and I/O speed
Less than 10 per cent of RAM is available right after start: a leaking service, a big CMA/carveout or missing zram.
Phones with little RAM rely on zram; without it lmkd kills apps much earlier. Check the fstab zramsize entry and the zram driver.
lmkd is not running: without it the system freezes or reboots when memory runs out. A wrong ro.lmk configuration makes it exit at start.
use_minfree_levels=true without use_new_strategy=true and with PSI disabled makes lmkd exit on recent Android versions, which leads to boot loops.
lmkd uses PSI but /proc/pressure/memory is missing: enable CONFIG_PSI (or backport it) or configure minfree levels with the new strategy.
Less than 10 per cent free: apps and updates may fail.
No eMMC/UFS information is readable by apps on this ROM.
The eMMC reports its reserved blocks as worn (pre_eol_info): back up and expect failures.
Writing a test file in the app data failed: /data full or an I/O error (check dmesg for mmc errors).
Very slow writes: the eMMC may run in a slow bus mode (no HS200/HS400), or the filesystem is mounted with sync/discard options.
Writes a file with fsync, reads it back and does random 4K writes. The file is deleted afterwards.
